Package qupath.ext.omero.core.pixelapis

package qupath.ext.omero.core.pixelapis
This package contains different methods to read the pixel values of an image.
  • The PixelApi interface contains information on an API that can read pixel values of an image. It can be used to create a PixelApiReader which is the class that will actually read pixel values.
  • The ice, web and mspixelbuffer packages contain different APIs to read pixel values.
